def best_cluster_labels(X, prefer="silhouette"):
    """Try a few clusterers and return labels from the best by silhouette."""
    candidates = []

    # KMeans
    for seed in [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 11, 42]:
        km = KMeans(n_clusters=2, n_init=50, random_state=seed)
        lab = km.fit_predict(X)
        candidates.append(("kmeans", seed, lab))
